brief: Prioritise Rushmere Junction for pre-event attention, and where an ageing unit cannot be attended before an event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure as directed in MG-023. Where a unit is identified for pre-event attention and a vegetation or obstruction defect is outstanding, clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity as specified in SOP-011. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period in accordance with MG-021.
